newsitem.title: USA: Top 10 movies at U.S. box office.
newsitem.headline: Top 10 movies at U.S. box office.

text.p: Following are movie ticket sales at the U.S. box office for the July 4-6 holiday weekend, according to studio estimates collected by Exhibitor Relations Co. on Sunday. Final data will be issued on Monday. 1 (*) Men in Black ............................ $51.0 million
8 (6) The Lost World: Jurassic Park ........... $2.7 million
NOTE: Last weekend's position in parentheses. * denotes new release.
"Men in Black" has earned a total of $84.1 million since its July 2 release, a figure that includes Tuesday-night previews.
The picture is released by Columbia Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp.. Sony's TriStar studio released "My Best Friend's Wedding."
"Face/Off" is released by Paramount Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc..
"Hercules" and "Con Air" are released by Walt Disney Co. .
"Batman & Robin" and "Wild America" are released by Warner Bros, a unit of Time Warner Inc..
"The Lost World: Jurassic Park" is released by Universal Studios, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd..
"Out to Sea" and "Speed 2: Cruise Control" are released by 20th Century Fox, a unit of News Corp..
